script: if test "$1" = --list-types; then printf 'text/plain\n'; else test "$*" = '--no-newline --type text/plain' || exit 9; printf 'synthetic input'; fi
if test "$1" = --list-types; then printf 'text/plain;charset=utf-8\n'; else test "$*" = '--no-newline' || exit 9; printf 'synthetic input'; fi
if test "$1" = --list-types; then exit 1; else test "$*" = '--no-newline' || exit 9; printf 'synthetic input'; fi
if test "$1" = --list-types; then printf 'text/plain\n'; else printf 'synthetic-error' >&2; exit 1; fi
